summary.text: John Barrett is a Democratic state representative from the 1st Berkshire District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since November 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the House Committee on Operations, Facilities and Security and previously served as mayor of North Adams for 26 years.
